outcome: rapid and sustained resolution of allergic inflammation
deep symptom control including normalization of the skin microbiome
cohort: A 9-week-old infant diagnosed with Netherton syndrome.
finding: Treatment with dupilumab off-label in a 9-week-old infant with Netherton syndrome led to rapid and sustained resolution of allergic inflammation, deep symptom control including normalization of the skin microbiome, and catch-up somatic and psychomotor development without adverse drug reactions.
